newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power drops on cool weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power drops on cool weather.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the U.S. Mid-Atlantic region dropped Tuesday on an outlook of cooler and drier weather moving into the territory by Wednesday, brokers and traders said.
"It's still muggy, but tomorrow, we'll see temperatures in the 70's (Fahrenheit degrees)," said one regional trader, if rain falls in the region overnight.

Although short-term electricity in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect power pool were lower from Monday's levels, tight generation capacity tied to plant outages offset the weather-related bearishness, traders said.
At least four generating stations in PJM, with a combined capacity near 3,000 megawatt (MW), were idled for refueling and/or maintenance.

The plants include General Utilities Corp's 610 MW Oyster Creek nuclear plant in Forked River, N.J.; Delmarva Power & Light Co's 442 MW Indian River 4 coal unit in Millsboro, Del.; Pennsylvania Power & Light Co's 1,090 MW Susquehanna 1 nuclear unit in Berwick, Pa.; and GPU Generation Inc's 850 Conemaugh 1 coal unit near Johnstown, Pa.
PECO Energy CO's 1,100 MW Peachbottom 2 nuclear unit in Delta, Pa., is expected to be shut Friday for 29 days for refueling.
PJM firm, peak electricity prices for Wednesday were assessed at $31.00-$34.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), down from Monday's range of $33.00-$36.00 for Tuesday delivery.
PJM firm, peak electricity for the rest of the week was discussed at $26.50-$26.75, versus Monday's $27.00-$28.00.
PJM prices, with similar delivery terms, for next week were $22.00-$23.00, compared with Monday's $23.00 level.
Peak power for firm, peak delivery for the balance of September was valued between $20.75 and $22.90, compared with Monday's $22.50-$23.50 range.
October PJM power was again pegged at $20.50-$20.80, unchanged from Monday's range.
November PJM electricity was quoted at $21.65-$21.85, up slightly from $21.50-$21.70 on Monday.
Peak, firm PJM prices for the 1996 fourth quarter were assessed at $22.70-$22.80, up from Monday's $22.50-$22.75.
